title: Process gate: the documents (and their status) that procurement, Owner acceptance, construction, commissioning / acceptance or operations need before a step, with the need date from the plan

description.description: what the gate checks (titles carry no bracketed text)

requires.description: '[any:]<selector>[|<selector>...][?] <STATUS>': selector type:<TYPE> | rule:<DL-...> | id:<document> | bdp | construction | ewp-first | ewp-all, optionally bound with @mr (packages of the scope), @plant (plant-level documents), @epc / @supplier (originator), combined with commas (@mr,epc); '|' unites the documents of several selectors; trailing '?' = optional (no document selected is not a finding); 'any:' = met when one selected document has the status; STATUS IFR | IFA | ACCEPTED | IFC | AB. Gates with need 'po' set the planned PO (EPC documents only); gates with a milestone / activity / CWP need make it the need date of the EPC documents they require

need.description: enquiry | po | fabrication | shipment | ros (mr scope); cwp_start | cwp_mid (cwp scope); activity:<id> (early finish); milestone:<id> (planned month after NTP)

offset_days.description: added to the need date (negative = earlier)
